About the Master Class

Ever bought a viral skincare product only to find out it doesn’t work for you? That’s because everyone has different skin, and what works for everyone may not work for you. Maybe you didn’t use the right amount or simply bought something that would never work for you. In this exclusive Master Class, Dr. Natasha V will teach you how to choose skincare ingredients that are the right fit for your skin, identify mistakes and help you achieve glowing, healthy skin 2x faster.

settings.heading: Alia, Kriti & Deepika never reveal these skincare secrets!

settings.content: Viral skincare ingredients - temporary or here to stay?
Guide to picking the right ingredients for your skin type
Mistakes to avoid with actives in skincare

Dr Natasha Vijayendran (MBBS, MD) is a medical professional with significant expertise in dermatology. Throughout her 9 year career, she has established herself as a Consultant Dermatologist, focusing on hair restoration, anti-ageing treatments, acne, and pigmentation. Her proficiency extends to being a skilled Hair Transplant and Laser Surgeon, offering a wealth of knowledge through her clinics in Gurgaon and Mumbai.
